arguments.summary: Critical firewall integrity breach detected and mitigated. A compromised host (WS-FIN-042) was beaconing to a Cobalt Strike C2 server. During containment, a firewall integrity alert revealed exploitation of CVE-2026-21884, resulting in corruption of 47 inbound ACL rules on the primary perimeter firewall. Immediate remediation included blocking the C2 server, resetting the user's credentials, scanning the endpoint, and executing a full Ansible-based remediation playbook. The corrupted firewall rules were identified and required deletion of all inbound rules for recovery.

Lateral movement detected: SMB access from WS-FIN-042 to file server 10.0.3.10.
Firewall integrity alert received: Firmware verification hash mismatch detected on primary firewall (10.0.1.1).
Containment initiated: Blocked C2 server 198.51.100.23 at firewall.
User CORP\jsmith credentials reset via IAM/PAM system.
Full endpoint scan completed on WS-FIN-042; 1 threat detected.
Ansible remediation playbook 'remediate_cobalt_strike.yml' executed successfully on WS-FIN-042.
Critical finding: 47 inbound firewall rules corrupted via CVE-2026-21884. Immediate deletion of all inbound rules initiated.

title: Unsigned DLL Loaded via Rundll32 from Temp Directory
description: Detects execution of rundll32.exe loading an unsigned DLL from a temporary directory, a common technique for DLL sideloading.
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection:
        Image|endswith: '\\rundll32.exe'
        OriginalFileName: null or OriginalFileName: ''
        CommandLine|contains:
            - '%TEMP%'
            - '%LocalAppData%'
            - '\\AppData\\Local\\Temp'
    condition: selection
level: high
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1218/011/
    - https://redcanary.com/blog/dll-sideloading/
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate software installers using self-extracting archives
    - Rare development tools
author: SOC Team

arguments.summary: A Golden Ticket attack was executed following an initial phishing compromise on WS-FIN-042 (user jsmith). The attacker deployed Cobalt Strike, established C2 communication, and performed lateral movement. Detection systems identified suspicious network activity and encoded PowerShell, leading to the discovery of a full domain-level compromise via Kerberos TGT exfiltration. Immediate actions included blocking C2 IPs, resetting the krbtgt account, disabling all Domain Admins, and remediating the initial host.

All Domain Admin accounts disabled and credentials reset; krbtgt password reset twice.
Host WS-FIN-042 hardened via Ansible playbook.

title: Internal Network Scanning from Low-Criticality Assets
id: 5a3e8d9f-1c2b-4f55-94e1-1a8b9c7d1e2f
description: Detect internal SYN scans originating from low-criticality IT assets to prevent alert fatigue on benign admin activity.
status: test
date: 2026-04-09
author: SOC Team

  category: firewall
  product: fortinet
  service: netflow
detection:
  selection:
    src_ip: 10.0.0.0/8
    dest_ip: 10.0.0.0/8
    protocol: tcp
    flags: SYN
    flow_bytes: < 1000
    connection_count: > 50
    by: src_ip
    timeframe: 60s
  asset_filter:
    src_asset_criticality: low
    src_asset_department: IT
  condition: selection and asset_filter
falsepositives:
  - Routine vulnerability or network scanning by IT staff
level: medium
